full_p9.source_policy: GE1 committed ref admission; remaining main unchanged

H1.rule: GD4: lighting owner-group mismatches are reported separately; all other pairing failures remain gated. Pair the same capture index only when sweep, player view and injected anomaly/target state agree. Compare per-actor private ID silhouette with the separate legacy label-path silhouette; shared IDs are reported as groups. An unpaired state is reported and never replaced by a pixel-selected reference. Require nonempty opaque, masked, WPO and blink-hidden coverage. IoU floor 0.98; empty vs empty is recorded separately. P4 uses the kept magenta classifier R>220,G<40,B>220 and max RGB change>32 on every paired saved frame.

H1_H2_H3.census_counts: Every paired object/frame has equal pixel counts;0 unpaired groups;0 lighting groups in this default-route pair.

custom_depth.rule: GD5 removes the bench plant; before/mid/after states must be identical, enabled and tagged counts zero

limitations: EA_Core and outline qualification contain static targets; no skeletal target exists in EA_Core. Dynamic collectors for ISM/HISM/skeletal are compiled, with unsupported faithful-draw cases unavailable and excluded, but no live skeletal or instance proof is claimed here.
GPU/CPU costs are instrumented incremental private-pass work, not a whole-engine on/off benchmark. Shared staging/readback and PNG writing are excluded.
Private ID uses its own stencil attachment. All zero-write state claims refer to host custom depth, component stencil values/write masks and r.CustomDepth.
